articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点在于测量对象由电子跃迁转向原子核跃迁，这可能带来更高性能的时间频率基准；但已知内容没有披露精度、稳定性或应用落地时间等具体指标，后续仍需看《自然》论文与工程化验证。

articles.summary: 文章说，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗在巴西总统选举首轮建立领先优势，可能意味着亚马孙雨林至少未来四年面临更多火灾、灰烬、犯罪与死亡，并更快逼近不可逆转的临界点。尽管卢拉总统在遏制亚马孙毁林方面取得成效，但这一成效未转化为选举胜利，外界比巴西选民更担忧。值得关注，因为巴西政治走向可能直接影响全球重要生态系统的保护窗口。

articles.sourceExcerpt: Inquest under way into why President Lula’s success in curbing Amazon deforestation has not led to success at polls More fire, more ash, more crime, more death. And a globally important ecosystem driven ever more rapidly towards a point of no return. That is the prospect for the Amazon rainforest for at least the next four years if Flávio Bolsonaro holds on to the lead he established this week in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election.

articles.title: Separatists win in Quebec – but does that bring separation from Canada any closer?
articles.highlight: 魁人党新增56席、得票率翻倍，却仍差五席未过半，使其在特朗普2028年离任后举行公投的承诺几乎无法实现。
articles.summary: 魁人党在魁北克周一的选举中获胜，拿下14年来首次执政权，议席增加56个、得票率较2022年翻倍。但该党距多数政府仍差五席，这让它在特朗普2028年卸任后举行独立公投的招牌承诺变得几乎不可能兑现。加拿大统一所受的威胁，可能并不像乍看之下那么大。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键结论：赢得选举不等于掌握推进公投的制度条件；缺少多数议席，使分离议程在可预见的时间内难以落地，加之与特朗普的贸易战背景，独立诉求更受牵制。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Lack of majority for Parti Québécois puts any referendum in doubt, especially amid bruising trade war with Trump The victory of the Parti Québécois in Monday’s election in Quebec might seem to bring its signature goal, of separating the French-speaking province from Canada, much closer – but Canadian unity may not be nearly as threatened as may first seem. The PQ’s victory was both impressive and disappointing. The party added 56 seats to its roster and more than doubled its vote share compared with the 2022 election, giving it its first taste of power in 14 years.

en.highlight: Crucially, however, it was left five seats short of a majority, making its promise to hold a referendum after Donald Trump leaves office in 2028 nearly impossible.
en.summary: The Parti Québécois won Monday's election in Quebec, gaining 56 seats and more than doubling its vote share to take power for the first time in 14 years. Yet it remains five seats short of a majority, making its signature promise of a referendum after Trump leaves office in 2028 nearly impossible to keep. Canadian unity may not be as threatened as it first appears.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: winning an election is not the same as having the institutional conditions to hold a referendum; without a majority, the separatist agenda is hard to advance, especially amid a bruising trade war with Trump.

articles.title: A Constellation of Amazements: An Illustrated Love Letter to the Joy of Collecting Things
articles.highlight: 偏好升到最高形式便触及惊奇——对某种如此切己而狂喜之物竟能存在，心怀欣然的难以置信。
articles.summary: 人类是有惊奇能力的狩猎采集者，会为容纳现实的混沌而寻找组织原则，并把所遇之物编成分类与等级。文章把“偏好”视为人性中最奇特的部分，也是个体从物种整体中雕琢自我的方式；它值得一读，因为这篇图文礼赞收藏与偏好，提醒我们热情和惊奇如何塑造自我。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：收藏与偏好并非无谓癖好，而是人以分类、等级和喜爱在混沌中安放自我、抵达惊奇的方式。
articles.sourceExcerpt: We are hunter-gatherers with a capacity for amazement, wired to search for an organizing principle by which to contain the chaos of reality. We organize what we find into categories and hierarchies, hovering over which is one of the strangest things about being human: preference. How odd to have a strong feeling about a color or an object or a sequence of chords.

en.highlight: Preference taken to its highest form touches amazement — the glad disbelief that something so personally relevant and rapturous could exist.
en.summary: The essay describes humans as hunter-gatherers with a capacity for amazement, searching for an organizing principle to contain the chaos of reality. It treats preference—our strange strong feelings about a color, object, or chord—as how we sculpt the self from the species, and its highest form as amazement. Camelo Guerrero3 1Independent Researcher, France 2Independent Researcher, Germany 3School of Information T echnology, Y ork University, T oronto, Canada Abstract Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain–computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. articles.title: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Expert analysis
articles.summary: Michael Lynch 的写作建议被转述为软件博客常见反模式：开篇绕弯、误判读者已有知识、假定读者读过旧文、过度正式，以及用链接代替术语解释。Simon Willison 特别认同一条标准：文章不点链接也应能读懂；他还强调用自己的声音写作，因为 AI 代写正让博客变得平淡同质。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键 takeaway 是：博客写作应以读者理解为中心，少用链接逃避解释，并保留个人语气；在 AI 代写普及的环境里，有性格的表达反而是稀缺优势。
articles.highlight: 随着许多开发者把写作委托给 AI，软件博客正变得乏味而同质，读者渴望有个人风格的文字。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging Some excellent writing advice from Michael Lynch. Michael warns against "meandering intros", misjudging your reader's existing knowledge, assuming they'll read your previous posts, and excessive formality. He also warns against overreliance on links as an excuse not to explain terminology.

en.highlight: With so many developers delegating their writing to AI, software blogging is becoming bland and homogenous. Readers are hungry for writing with personality.
en.summary: This piece relays Michael Lynch's writing advice and lists common anti-patterns in software blogging: meandering intros, misjudging the reader's prior knowledge, assuming they have read earlier posts, excessive formality, and using links instead of explaining terminology. Simon Willison highlights the rule that an article should still make sense even if the reader clicks no links, and stresses writing in your own voice because AI-assisted writing is making blogs bland and homogenous.
en.failureAnalysis: The practical takeaway is to optimize for reader comprehension: explain terms instead of hiding behind links, and keep a personal voice. As AI-generated writing spreads, personality becomes a scarce advantage.
